metadata_limits.scope: New Rust host contract parser; these input limits do not cap AROS application memory or executable size. Component archive bounds remain tied to their separately authenticated inventory/resource profile.
metadata_limits.behavior: Read a regular non-symlink file with a bound before parsing; enforce the same bound while reading to refuse growth. UTF-8 without BOM, one JSON value, recursive unique keys; exact schema validation follows. Security limits are tested at boundary and one byte/depth beyond.

static_core_binding.artifact: One native ami-rust executable per host, statically linking the shared Rust host core.
static_core_binding.frontends: Install cargo-ami as a byte-identical regular-file copy of ami-rust; argv0 and the Cargo-injected ami token select frontend normalization. Both call the same parser/dispatcher.
static_core_binding.cli_sha256: SHA-256 over the exact accepted native executable file bytes.
static_core_binding.core_sha256: The same containing executable SHA-256, equal to cli_sha256 for this static-core contract. No separate .rlib, dynamic library or source-tree digest is substituted.
static_core_binding.other_helpers: Any separate compiler guard or linker executable has its own exact authenticated inventory entry; reusing the core source does not exempt its executable bytes from verification.
static_core_binding.alias_verification: Both frontend paths must be owned regular executable files with the same accepted byte length and digest; replacing either with a different program fails package/retained-inventory validation.
static_core_binding.retention: Retained copies bind their own original host/CLI/SDK/package identities; a newer global CLI never silently reinterprets an older retained record.
